info.name: Macro Markets Public Market Data
info.description: Read-only GraphQL examples for the existing Macro Markets public API. No API_TOKEN, Authorization value, private account data or mutations are included. This file is not proof of marketplace publication.

body.raw: {"query":"query PublicMarkets($first: Int!, $page: Int, $language: String!) { marketsPredictions(first: $first, page: $page, language: $language) { data { id title slug currency_code status } paginatorInfo { total currentPage } } }","variables":{"first":5,"page":1,"language":"en"}}

request.description: Public discovery query. No Macro account token is needed. Results and market availability change over time.

body.raw: {"query":"query PublicCategories($language: String) { marketPredictionCategories(first: 10, language: $language, enabled: true) { data { id name slug } } }","variables":{"language":"en"}}

request.description: Read-only category discovery. No Macro account token or financial action.
